$comment: Authoritative catalog of shared Agents, Codex, Claude, Devin, and Pi assets physically present in this repository. See scripts/validate_catalog.py for structural checks and docs/skill-installer-contract.md for the installer contract this catalog feeds.

hooks.$comment: The one Claude settings-hooks adapter. Both notifier scripts are materialized on every host; the installer wires exactly one of them into settings.json, chosen by the host OS (`posix-script` on POSIX, `windows-script` on native Windows), because a POSIX invocation cannot run on Windows and vice versa.

configs.$comment: Leaf-merged into Devin's config.json. The adapter preserves unrelated settings and refuses to overwrite differing unmanaged or modified managed values.

boundary_notes.$comment: These assets belong to other installers and must never appear as installable catalog entries.

foreign.note: Outside Agents ownership and management; never installed, updated, or pruned by Agents.
